ticker.name: BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund, Inc.

business_summary: BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund, Inc. is a close ended fixed income mutual fund launched by BlackRock, Inc. The fund is managed by BlackRock Advisors, LLC. It invests in the fixed income markets of United States. The fund invests primarily in long-term, investment grade municipal obligations exempt from federal income taxes and New Jersey personal income taxes. The fund was formerly known as BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Insured Fund. BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund, Inc. was formed in 1998 and is domiciled in United States.
business_summary_ko: BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund, Inc.는 BlackRock, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 BlackRock Advisors, LLC가 관리합니다. 미국 채권시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 주로 연방 소득세 및 뉴저지 개인 소득세가 면제되는 장기 투자 등급 지방자치단체에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 이전에 BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Insured Fund로 알려졌습니다. BlackRock MuniHoldings New Jersey Quality Fund, Inc.는 1998년에 설립되었으며 미국에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
